The study's Q basis puts the span-OV ceiling at 18.0 V (the original hot-load span). The out-D33 hot-load campaign was re-run at a 19 V span (`validation-results/01-switching-parasitics/round17/delegation/out-D33/rail-hot-19V/hot-load.json`, 128 / 128); against that 19.0 V ceiling the s45 span-OV upper corner has +0.4016 V.

## Ledger stresses

- 2EDR8259X VDD at the span-OV trip upper corner: 18.5984 V = 0.8856 of the 21 V operating maximum.
- TL431B: VKA max 2.541 V (REF tied to K); IK 5.652..7.291 mA over the operating span 15.5689..18.5984 V; 9.786 mA, 24.87 mW (5.12 K at 206 C/W) at the 24.0 V fault case.
- Fault case: V24_RAW nominal 24 V on the span (LS LDO pass short); PS2's own tolerance / OVP is not in the ledger, so this is a stated case, not a bound.
